## Kind of change

- [ ] New game
- [ ] Content pack (`packs/`)
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Fix or improvement to an existing game
- [ ] Docs or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `node tools/build.mjs` run, and `node tools/check.mjs` says "All checks passed."
- [ ] Opened from a file (`file://`) or a web address, it loads nothing from other sites.
- [ ] Every new text is in `strings.js`, in English and Spanish.
- [ ] Readable from the back of a room: the main text scales with the screen; buttons are at least 44 px.
- [ ] Works with a mouse, with touch and with a keyboard.
- [ ] All art is my own or openly licensed (source given). No characters from films, anime or games.
- [ ] No personal data about students leaves the browser.
- [ ] Code under MIT, content under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-CONTENT.md).
